Name: Miizuki's Seasonal Foresty Farm Buildings Alternative Textures Version
Author: glymr
TagLine: Miizuki kindly gave permission to make an Alternative Textures version of the fantastic "Seasonal Foresty Farm Buildings by Miizuki". The original Content Patcher version can be found here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1502.
Description:
Miizuki kindly gave permission to make an Alternative Textures version of the fantastic "Seasonal Foresty Farm Buildings by Miizuki". The original Content Patcher version can be found here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1502. All of the assets are Miizuki's; I just turned them into an Alternative Textures pack. Both the Vanilla and Starblue versions are included!

The original mod was created before 1.4, so it only has a small shed and two obelisk options. I have used the small shed image for both the small and large sheds in this pack. I'd love to see other buildings in this style! It's one of my favorite mod packs, even though it's older. It's great for the early game on a Forest map.

This pack includes both the Vanilla versions and the Starblue versions. You can search for the Starblue version by typing "Starblue" into the search field when using the paint can with Alternative Textures. You can search for both versions with the terms, "overgrown", "foresty", and "miizuki".

I've tested it some, but there could definitely still be bugs. Please let me know if you run across any! Thanks so much. :)
